description: Defines the implementation class srs_scheduler_impl for scheduling SRS resources in a cellular network, including methods for managing UEs, scheduling slots, and handling positioning requests.

classes.name: srs_scheduler_impl
classes.description: Implements the srs_scheduler interface to manage SRS scheduling, UEs, and positioning in a cellular network.

methods.name: run_slot
methods.description: Schedules SRS for the current slot.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Stops the scheduler, called on cell deactivation.

methods.name: handle_positioning_measurement_stop
methods.description: Stops positioning measurement for a given RNTI.
